title: Index documents
summary: index names files to try when a request refers to a directory. index.html is a common first page.
introduction: index names files to try when a request refers to a directory. index.html is a common first page. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: index names files to try when a request refers to a directory. index.html is a common first page.
A request for a directory can use its index.html. The file must actually exist and be readable.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Explain what should happen if the index file is missing.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: An index directive does not create the file.
For more detail later, use this [Nginx further reading](https://nginx.org/en/docs/beginners_guide.html).
